title: Shoprite bought OK Bazaars for R1 #Shoprite
text:
The first Shoprite opened in Wynberg, Cape Town, in 1966. In 1979 a group led by Whitey Basson, backed by Christo Wiese, bought the eight-store business for R1 million. It listed on the JSE in 1986 (worth about R29 million), bought Checkers in 1991 for R55 million, opened in Soweto in 1994, and at the end of 1997 bought OK Bazaars for R1. Today: 3,710 stores, about 174,000 people, and a business worth close to R200 billion.
